idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: Checking the Water Meter Leak Indicator
description: Hidden supply line leaks can waste thousands of liters before visible dampness appears. To test your system without specialized equipment, isolate all water fixtures in the house, including ice makers and filling valves. Locate your main municipal or private water meter register face. Most mechanical water meters feature a small triangular, star-shaped, or circular low-flow indicator dial designed to rotate during minute flow rates. If all fixtures are fully shut and this low-flow gear is turning, water is actively escaping somewhere downstream of the meter. Have you used this meter check to troubleshoot suspect piping systems?
image_prompt: A crisp, photorealistic close-up photo of a clean brass mechanical water meter installed on a residential copper water supply line. The meter dial face is clearly visible in the center of the frame, showing a clear glass cover, a digital reading counter, and a distinct small red triangular low-flow leak indicator dial. A polished brass ball valve with a blue handle is connected upstream of the meter with realistic soldered fittings. Clean indoor utility basement environment with realistic soft overhead lighting. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio composition, clear space at the top and bottom third for visual layout balance. High detail on brass texture, pipe geometry, and glass transparency. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no fake brand labels.
visual_story: The viewer immediately sees a realistic residential water meter assembly. The focal point is the meter register face, specifically highlighting the small red low-flow indicator wheel. By showing the mechanical connection between the main shutoff valve, copper line, and meter face, the visual teaches viewers exactly where to look on a real water meter to verify active, unrecorded water movement in a building.

on_image_text.explanation: If all home fixtures are off and the meter indicator wheel spins, water is actively escaping.
on_image_text.takeaway: Test your meter before hunting through walls for concealed supply leaks.
